mapper.sql: select t.id, t.tenant_id, t.tenant_name, t.tenant_desc, t.trade_info, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.province_id, t.city_id, t.county_id, t.dept_id, p.AREA_NAME as province_name, c.AREA_NAME as city_name,co.AREA_NAME as county_name from sys_tenant_info t left join sys_area p on t.province_id = p.AREA_CODE left join sys_area c on t.city_id= c.AREA_CODE left join sys_area co on t.county_id= co.AREA_CODE
mapper.select: where t.del_flag = '0' and t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select distinct a.industry_code,a.app_ver_code,a.app_ver_name,a.img_url from sys_industry_ver_conf a left join vm_order_package b on a.industry_code = b.industry_code and a.app_ver_code = b.app_ver_code left join vm_order_package_his c on a.industry_code = c.industry_code and a.app_ver_code = c.app_ver_code where b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and c.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select distinct * from ( select tenant_id,industry_code,app_ver_code from vm_order_customer union all select tenant_id,industry_code,app_ver_code from vm_order_customer_his ) a
select count(1) from sys_tenant_info where tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = '0'

select t.tenant_id as customerCode, t.tenant_name as customerName, t.province_id as cusRegistryProvince, t.city_id as cusRegistryCity, u.USER_NAME as admin, u.PHONENUMBER as phoneNum, t.city_id as admArea FROM sys_tenant_info t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id and u.is_tenant_admin = 1 and u.del_flag = '0' where t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update sys_tenant_info set del_flag = 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: select SUBSTRING(max(tenant_id),3) from sys_tenant_info where tenant_id like concat(#{prefix},'%')
mapper.update: update sys_dept set industry_code = #{targetIndustryCode}, app_ver_code = #{targetAppVerCode} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{sourceIndustryCode} and del_flag = '0'
update bm_grid set industry_code = #{targetIndustryCode} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{sourceIndustryCode} and delete_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM bm_grid WHERE delete_flag = '0' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{targetIndustryCode}
select count(*) from resource_type where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and delete_flag = 0;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `resource_type`(`RESOURCE_TYPE_ID`, `RESOURCE_TYPE_NAME`, `PARENT_ID`, `PARENT_NAME`, `ORDER_NUM`, `STATUS`, `TENANT_ID`, `REMARK`, `ICON`, `APPROVE`, `TYPE_LEVEL_URL`, `industry_code`, `app_ver_code`, `creator`, `create_time`, `modifier`, `update_time`, `delete_flag`) select RESOURCE_TYPE_ID,RESOURCE_TYPE_NAME,"0",null,order_num,`STATUS`,#{tenantId},REMARK,icon,approve, TYPE_LEVEL_URL,industry_code, app_ver_code, #{creator}, now(), null, null, 0 from resource_type_int where industry_code = #{targetIndustryCode} and app_ver_code = #{targetAppVerCode};
mapper.select: select dept_id, TENANT_TOWER_DEPT_ID, TENANT_NAME, CREATE_BY from sys_dept where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and parent_id = '000000' and dept_level = '1' and del_flag = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_dept set del_flag = 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode};
update bm_grid set delete_flag = 1 where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode};
mapper.select: select device_code,device_type from vm_organ_device_rel_t where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode};
select province_code, city_code, county_code, street_code from vm_organ_street_rel_t where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode};
mapper.update: call transferIndustryBaseInfo(#{tenantId, mode=IN}, #{sourceIndustryCode, mode=IN}, #{sourceAppVerCode, mode=IN}, #{targetIndustryCode, mode=IN}, #{targetAppVerCode, mode=IN});

call transferOrderIndustryBaseInfo(#{tenantId, mode=IN}, #{acceptNode, mode=IN}, #{sourceIndustryCode, mode=IN}, #{sourceAppVerCode, mode=IN}, #{targetIndustryCode, mode=IN}, #{targetAppVerCode, mode=IN});
update sys_user set dept_id = #{targetRootDeptId} where dept_id like concat(#{sourceRootDeptId}, '%') and is_tenant_admin = 0 and tenant_id = #{tenantId};
mapper.select: select industry_name from sys_industry_conf where industry_code = #{industryCode} limit 1;

select a.AREA_CODE areaCode, concat(a2.AREA_NAME,a1.AREA_NAME,a.AREA_NAME) areaName, a.LONGITUDE longitude, a.LATITUDE latitude from sys_area a left join sys_area a1 on a.AREA_PARENT_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE left join sys_area a2 on a1.AREA_PARENT_CODE = a2.AREA_CODE where a.AREA_CODE = #{areaCode}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_tenant_info( tenant_id, tenant_name, dept_id, province_id, city_id, trade_info, del_flag, del_flag, create_by, create_time )values( #{param.tenantId}, #{param.tenantName}, #{param.deptId}, #{param.provinceId}, #{param.cityId}, #{param.tradeInfo}, #{param.delFlag}, #{param.createBy}, #{param.createTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id AS tenantId, d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id, d.parent_name, d.MDM_ORG_CODE as mdmOrgCode, d.industry_code as industryCode FROM sys_dept d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.INDUSTRY_CODE=#{industryCode}

SELECT DISTINCT d.* from sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_role_dept rd ON d.DEPT_ID=rd.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.ROLE_ID = rd.ROLE_ID WHERE d.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND d.INDUSTRY_CODE = #{industryCode} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * from sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' and DEPT_ID like concat(#{deptId},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT a.AREA_CODE areaCode, concat(a2.AREA_NAME,a1.AREA_NAME,a.AREA_NAME) areaName, a.LONGITUDE longitude, a.LATITUDE latitude from sys_dept_street_rel r left join sys_area a on r.county_code = a.AREA_CODE left join sys_area a1 on a.AREA_PARENT_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE left join sys_area a2 on a1.AREA_PARENT_CODE = a2.AREA_CODE WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and r.industry_code=#{industryCode} ${dataScope}
